name: What type of paint finish is best for garage walls?

mainEntity.name: What type of paint finish is best for garage walls?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should choose an interior acrylic latex paint in an eggshell, satin, or semi-gloss finish for garage walls. Flat or matte finishes absorb scuffs, dust, and car exhaust, making them difficult to wash down. Satin and semi-gloss offer better moisture resistance and wipe down easily when dirt or grease splatters. If your garage walls are bare drywall, you must apply a dedicated PVA drywall primer first to seal the porous surface and ensure even adhesion for the finish paint.
acceptedAnswer.description: Satin or semi-gloss acrylic latex paint is best because it resists moisture, wipes clean easily, and handles scuffs much better than flat paint.
